item.title: Codex Mobile with Third-Party API: Exploiting the Auth/Model Layer Decoupling
item.description: Got Codex Mobile working with a third-party API relay. The key insight: Auth and Model layers are fully decoupled — ChatGPT handles identity, coding.rexai.top handles inference. Full configuration guide included.
